post.description: Add quantity to a phone. Automatically updates availability to IN_STOCK or LOW_STOCK.

example.message: Added 15 units to 'iPhone 15 Pro Max'. Current stock is now 30.

post.description: Deduct quantity from a phone. Validates that current stock is sufficient. Auto-marks SOLD_OUT when stock reaches 0.

example.message: Deducted 5 units from 'iPhone 15 Pro Max'. Current stock is now 25.

patch.description: Instantly mark a phone as SOLD_OUT with optional stock reset.

example.message: Phone 'iPhone 15 Pro Max' marked as SOLD_OUT.

get.description: Retrieve only currently running active offers for Home page (C-01) and Offers page (C-12).
Check if a specific phone model has an active running offer (C-02, C-03).

Returns side-by-side comparison for 2 or 3 phones including photo, price, offer price, savings, warranty, stock status, colors, storages, specs, accessories, and monthly installment calculations. Saved in customer browser.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs of 2 or 3 phones to compare (e.g. 2,3 or 2,3,4)

200.description: Side-by-side comparison matrix and enriched phones

example.message: Successfully retrieved side-by-side comparison for 2 phones.

400.description: Invalid selection (less than 2 or more than 3 phones)

404.description: One or more selected phones not found

get.summary: Retrieve live phone details for saved favorites (SRS C-06)
